title: Count Servers that Communicate
description: Count servers that can communicate with at least one other server in the same row or column.
pseudocode:
1. rowCounts = array of zeros
2. colCounts = array of zeros
3. For each cell (r, c) if grid[r][c] == 1: rowCounts[r]++, colCounts[c]++
4. count = 0
5. For each cell (r, c) if grid[r][c] == 1 and (rowCounts[r] > 1 or colCounts[c] > 1): count++

steps.note: Calculating row and column counts: grid is [[1,0],[1,1]]. rowCounts=[2,1], colCounts=[1,1].
Checking cell [0,0]: rowCount=2 > 1. Server can communicate.
Checking cell [1,0]: rowCount=2 > 1 (or colCount=1). Server can communicate.
Checking cell [1,1]: rowCount=2 > 1 or colCount=1. Server can communicate.
